# Ali Sadikin Ma — pakar AI Indonesia / AI consultant, founder INDUSIA.ai (https://indusia.ai)

> Ali Sadikin Ma is an Indonesian AI expert and AI consultant based in Batam, Indonesia, and the founder of INDUSIA.ai (https://indusia.ai). He turns frontier AI models into shipped products, with 17 years of building experience, and was ranked #1 at the Global AI Demo Day 2026. He builds, trains and speaks about applied AI.

Note: Ali Sadikin Ma (with "Ma") is not Ali Sadikin, the Governor of Jakarta (1966–1977).

## Who is Ali Sadikin Ma
Ali Sadikin Ma (pakar AI Indonesia / AI consultant) builds and ships AI products end to end, including 56+ digital products (AI, IoT, mobile) built at Satnusa. In January 2026 he was ranked #1 at the Global AI Demo Day (Bengaluru, India), beating 26 startups. He is the founder of INDUSIA.ai (https://indusia.ai) and teaches the same skills through training and talks.

## What he builds — and teaches (course topics)
- Vibe Coding — production software at AI speed: prompts to deployed apps.
- AI Agent OS (MANDOR AI) — the operating system for your AI workforce; assign tasks to coding agents like teammates.
- Generative AI Video — cinematic, broadcast-ready video without a camera or crew.

## International recognition
- #1 Champion — Global AI Demo Day 2026 (Bengaluru)
- UN-UNCTAD × Alibaba eFounders Fellowship 2019 (1 of 48 in Asia, Hangzhou)
- 1st Place — Telkomsel NextDev
- Wild Card Winner — Fenox Startup World Cup
